## Use the sign of the index {#negative}

Evaluate the positive fractional power first. If the index is negative, take the reciprocal.

:::::: {.example-pair}

::::: {.model}

<h3>Worked example</h3>

$125^{\frac23}$

::: {.fragment}

[Take the cube root, then square.]{.annotation}

$=(\sqrt[3]{125})^2$

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Use the cube root of 125.]{.annotation}

$=5^2=25$

:::

:::::

::::: {.paper}

::: {.fragment}

<h3>Your turn</h3>

$125^{-\frac23}$

Only the sign of the index changes. Use the worked example to find the new value.

:::

::: {.fragment}

[Check your working]{.annotation}

$=\dfrac{1}{125^{\frac23}}$

$=\dfrac{1}{5^2}=\dfrac{1}{25}$

:::
